translations.web: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
translations.bsb: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
translations.kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
